Hi Marissa / Alex — thanks for flagging. Attaching the June 2026 redacted pen test report and a one-page vulnerability management summary. High level answers to FinServ's questions below: 

- SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II auditor's report and the standard management assertion; full internal workpapers are not shared. Auditor: Kestrel Audit Partners; report period: Jan 1 - Jun 30, 2026.

- Pen test cadence: External (3rd-party) penetration tests are conducted quarterly by a PCI/ISO certified vendor; internal authenticated scans run weekly with agent-based scanners across prod hosts. Customers can request additional scans for dedicated deployments.

- Triage SLAs: Critical (P1) initial response within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours. High (P2) response within 72 hours. We operate a tracked ticketing process and will provide remediation timelines in the ticket.

- Disclosure policy: We support coordinated disclosure. For customer-impacting issues we notify affected customers via support tickets and send security advisories for high/critical incidents. We do not publish details that could enable exploitation until fixes are available.

- Vulnerability scanning: Weekly authenticated scans, daily dependabot/ SCA for dependencies, quarterly external pentests. We also validate fixes with follow-up scans.

Artifacts attached: redwood_pen_test_report_2026-06.pdf (redacted) and Redwood_vuln_process_1pager.pdf. I've uploaded both to a read-only Drive folder and shared the link with FinServ.
